name: What is the process for building an attached ADU with Cali View Builders?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for building an attached ADU with Cali View Builders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, property, and budget. Next, we move to design and architectural planning, ensuring compliance with local zoning laws and your preferences. Once designs are approved, we handle the permitting process with the local authorities. Construction then commences, with regular updates and quality control. Finally, we complete the project with a final walkthrough to ensure your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, design, permitting, construction, and a final walkthrough to ensure your attached ADU meets your expectations.
